question: Do weekly seasonality and recent averages improve next-day bike rental forecasts relative to a last-day naive forecast?
significance: Exercise a scientifically distinct input and evaluation type on an authentic curated UCI dataset.
hypothesis: At least one seasonal or moving-average baseline improves last-day MAE on the chronological final period.
falsifier: Neither lag-7 nor moving-average forecasts beat lag-1 on held-out MAE.
